text:
THE KENYA NATIONAL EXAMINATIONS COUNCIL

 PERFORMING ARTS
 SCORING GUIDE
 PART 1: PROJECT
 This paper consists of 5 printed pages.
 Turn Over
INSTRUCTIONS TO THE GRADE 7 TEACHER
This scoring guide is for Part 1 of the Project work (Performance). Part 2 (Appreciation) will
be assessed in the written paper.
You are required to:
 1. Read and internalize the Assessment Tasks and this Scoring Guide in preparation for
 assessment.
 2. Avail the Assessment Tasks to the Grade 7 learners at least three (3) weeks prior to
 assessment.
 3. Guide the Grade 7 learners through every step of the Assessment Tasks.
 4. Schedule a day for the assessment of Task 1.
 5. Set up an ideal environment/space, free of interruptions, for the assessment of this
 task.
 6. Use the Assessment Rubric provided to score task 1 as presented by each Grade 7
 learner.
 7. Record each learner’s scores on the Scoring Sheet provided.
 8. Upload the learners’ scores on the KNEC portal as guided.
 9. Ensure strict adherence to the assessment guidelines and timelines provided.
